name: Syun
source:
The pessimistic protagonist. Was bullied in the past and is often paranoid that his friends secretly hate him. Shy, anxious and introverted.

Underneath the grumpy armor, there is a very sensitive soul who just wants to be understood and loved for the way he is.

He is passionate about his hobbies, and has a cat colony that he dotes on.

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/doce-fim]official profile[/url]]
